acceptance.criterion: OtaValidationGate::mark_if_needed returns true exactly once per boot: first call true, all subsequent calls false.
ESP-IDF bootloader app-rollback is armed: sdkconfig.defaults sets CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE=y so a freshly-flashed image boots ESP_OTA_IMG_PENDING_VERIFY.

Running image is confirmed exactly once on first ConnectionState::MqttConnected via EspOta::mark_running_slot_valid, gated by OtaValidationGate; failures log a warning without crashing the health loop.
acceptance.verification: code inspection of ESP32-C3-CONTROLLER-NODE/src/runtime/health.rs plus ESP firmware cargo check

acceptance.criterion: No regressions: full hydragrow-controller-core test suite passes.

objective: Make a bad OTA release recoverable: after flashing, the ESP32-C3 controller confirms its image healthy (WiFi + MQTT reachable) before the bootloader commits to it, otherwise the bootloader auto-reverts to the last known-good firmware.
